opening.argument: The segment presents a conventional Target grocery promotion: shoppers who spend $50 on groceries receive a free $10 gift card. The offer is expressly tied to a retail purchase, with the stated condition that “you'll get a free $10 gift card if you spend $50 in groceries at Target.” Viewers are given ordinary redemption routes through the retailer’s app or by texting “grocery” to 827438, and the broadcast frame displays the same short-code instruction. The news-segment framing and retail footage reinforce that this is coverage of a time-limited shopping incentive, including disclosed exclusions for some items. Nothing described asks viewers to send payment, provide credentials, or surrender other sensitive information.

citations.quote: you'll get a free $10 gift card if you spend $50 in groceries at Target
You can get the coupon through their app or text grocery to 827438.
There are some items that do not count toward your $50.
